mapper.insert: INSERT INTO risk_outbox_events (id, tenant_id, aggregate_id, topic, tag, payload, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{tenantId}, #{aggregateId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{topic}, #{tag}, CAST(#{payload} AS JSONB), #{attemptCount}, #{nextAttemptAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT id FROM risk_outbox_events WHERE published_at IS NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND (claimed_until IS NULL OR claimed_until < #{now}) ORDER BY created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{limit} ) UPDATE risk_outbox_events event SET claim_token = #{claimToken, jdbcType=OTHER}, claimed_until = #{claimedUntil} FROM candidates WHERE event.id = candidates.id RETURNING event.*
mapper.update: UPDATE risk_outbox_events SET attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, dead_lettered_at = #{deadLetteredAt}, claimed_until = NULL, claim_token = NULL WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=OTHER} AND claim_token = #{claimToken, jdbcType=OTHER}
